_about: FEATURE-1 cluster goldens. Each cell encodes a repro command, the BUGGY-NOW signature (verified on the reference name-match binary tldr 0.4.1, 2026-06-30), and the EXPECTED-FIXED target. check.kind names a metric extractor in parity_lib.cluster_value; `buggy`/`fixed` are {op,value} predicates. cluster_status(value) => still_buggy | improved | fixed (or correct | regressed for positive controls). These cells are PROGRESS indicators reported by check_parity.py; the hard never-worse FAIL is the edge-set diff. {repo} -> corpora/<repo>; {feature1} -> this harness dir.

cells.note: Name-match: 19 targets named Read, several broadcasting ~180-218 identical callers. Fixed: per-receiver-class resolution, no single Read target with a ~180-wide broadcast.
19 distinct Read targets is the name-collision broadcast. Fixed: a call to .Read() resolves to few real receiver methods.
Buggy: 2 ReadNormal targets (a phantom in BsonDataReader.Async.cs) with 4 direct callers. Fixed: 1 target, 2 callers.
'size' broadcasts to ~10 targets. Fixed: per-receiver-type resolution narrows it sharply.
Win32 GetFileSize is mis-bound to gmock-gtest-all.cc. Fixed: GetFileSize is external (Win32 API).
isBuffer -> isBuffer self-edge (val.constructor.isBuffer mis-resolved to the local fn). Fixed: that callee is external, no self-recursion.
callees append/remove are bound to Deque/OrderedSet swift files; they are ContiguousArray methods and should be external.
Parser trait (derive.rs) and Parser struct (parser.rs) both expose parse and collide; callers mis-attributed across a 3-way broadcast. Fixed: trait/struct distinct, callers narrowed.
Table.render and TreeHelper.render both report caller_count 33 (identical) = cross-attribution. Fixed: per-receiver-class caller sets diverge.
PreparedRequest.prepare_url picks up 2 false conftest callers (httpbin, httpbin_secure via reference fallback). Fixed: the method keeps its 1 real caller; the free-fn variant keeps its 2.

Buggy: Component:setState (colon method on Component.lua) is absent; setState binds only to *.spec.lua targets (each cc 26, broadcast). Fixed: the colon-method binds to its enclosing Component class table.
colon-method `initialize` conflated across stream_*.lua classes. Fixed: each colon-method bound to its enclosing class table, callers per-receiver.

10 `minus` overloads collapse to 49 direct callers. Fixed: per-receiver/param-type resolution. (Companion fact: `impact Clock` correctly errors Function-not-found -> Clock stays external; that must not regress into spurious internal targets.)

POSITIVE CONTROL: a constructor-typed local receiver (c=Cat(); c.speak()) resolves per-type already on the reference binary. value 0 = correct. It MUST stay correct (no broadcast to the sibling class) through every stage; value 1 = regressed.
